title: 5FT Halloween Swinging Ghost Outdoor Decor,Spooky Hanging Ghost Decorations
features: 【Giant Light-Up Ghost Design】 Make your Halloween display unmissable with our 5FT tall sheer fabric ghost hanging swing! Crafted with soft, flowy white tulle that billows naturally in wind, this glowing ghost comes with a detachable black witch hat for two distinct styling looks—classic plain ghost or spooky witch ghost. Built-in warm white LED lights illuminate the sheer fabric from within, casting a soft eerie glow after dusk to create an unforgettable haunted house atmosphere for your yard

【8 Flash Light Modes and Timer】Built-in warm white glowing LED lights inside the ghost body, equipped with a remote for full light adjustment. You can switch steady light / flash mode, adjust brightness freely, and set 6H auto-off timer to save power. It runs on batteries (batteries not included), so you can hang it anywhere outdoors.

【Versatile Outdoor Halloween Decor】 Made with fade-resistant, water-repellent polyester tulle and rust-proof rope hardware, this hanging ghost swing is built for outdoor use—rain, light frost, and crisp fall wind won’t damage its lights or fabric. Ideal for front porch entryways, oak/maple trees, garden archways, lawn display setups, Halloween trick-or-treat yard decor, haunted house party props, fall festival decorations. Easy to assemble, store flat post-Halloween for reuse year after year.

【Wind-Activated Floating Phantom Effect】 Unlike rigid, static Halloween ornaments, our lightweight sheer ghost fabric flows naturally with every breeze. When the wind blows, the ghost sheet billows and swings on the wooden plank, creating a lifelike floating ghost illusion that brings dynamic haunted energy to your outdoor display. On calm nights, it hangs neatly as a glowing centerpiece surrounded by pumpkins, fall leaves and jack-o-lanterns for a stunning static Halloween backdrop.

【Perfect Halloween Gift 】 Whether you’re upgrading your own haunted yard display or shopping for a unique Halloween gift for family and friends, this glowing swing ghost delivers unmatched visual impact. Pair it with pumpkins, maple fall leaves and witch broom decor to build a cohesive, Instagram-worthy front yard Halloween scene that impresses every guest and trick-or-treater this October.
